results.name: qsort_dword_array
results.evidence: Classic median-of-three quicksort with an explicit pivot stack (auStack_f0/auStack_78) over an array of 4-byte elements (in_ECX..in_EAX), falling back to FUN_004496d0 for partitions of 8 or fewer elements and invoking a caller-supplied compare callback (param_1) exactly like a textbook qsort implementation.
results.summary: Sorts an array of 4-byte (dword/pointer) elements in place using quicksort with an insertion-sort fallback for small partitions and a caller-supplied comparison callback.

results.name: qsort_dword_array_shortsort
results.evidence: Called only from FUN_00449590 when a partition is small (<=8 elements); implements a selection-style pass that finds the maximum via the compare callback and swaps it to the end, the standard small-array fallback used by qsort implementations.
results.summary: Sorts a small sub-array of 4-byte elements in place, used as the small-partition fallback for the quicksort routine.

results.name: cutscene_start
results.evidence: Lazily initializes the saved music-gain sentinel DAT_00686b60 from DAT_007252a8, forces sound_set_music_gain(1.0), and sets cutscene/letterbox-active flags in DAT_0087a478, DAT_00880354 and DAT_006f187c (the same letterbox-state struct used by chimera__letterbox); mirrors FUN_00449eb0 which undoes this state.
results.summary: Begins a cutscene: saves a default music gain if none is saved, forces music to full volume, and marks the letterbox/cutscene state as active.

results.name: cutscene_letterbox_bar_draw
results.evidence: Builds a large zeroed widget-parameter block (unit scale factors of 1.0, screen-rect fields derived from in_ECX's 4 shorts) and passes it to FUN_0051c9a0 to render; called twice in a row from chimera__letterbox around the letterbox fade-in/out logic, consistent with drawing the top and bottom black bars.
results.summary: Draws one letterbox bar using a screen rectangle supplied via ECX, called once each for the top and bottom bars.

results.name: cutscene_title_queue
results.evidence: Scans up to 4 slots at DAT_006f187c+0xc (stride 4) for an empty (-1) entry and stores param_1 (a cutscene_titles index) plus a negative tick countdown computed as -(param_2*30) (30 ticks/sec); the same 4-slot array is iterated and drawn from in chimera__letterbox using scenario cutscene_titles data at scenario+0x500 (stride 0x60).
results.summary: Queues a cutscene title for display in one of up to four concurrent slots, scheduling it to start fading after the given delay in seconds.

results.name: cutscene_letterbox_update
results.evidence: Advances/draws the fading letterbox bars via two calls to FUN_00449780 based on DAT_006f187c's fade fields and elapsed time from DAT_006f1d6c+0xc, then iterates the 4-slot title queue populated by FUN_00449960, reading each entry's cutscene_titles record (scenario+0x500, stride 0x60) to compute fade alpha and drawing it through chimera__draw_16_bit_text; matches the Chimera-signature name 'letterbox' but also drives cutscene subtitle rendering.
results.summary: Per-frame update that fades and draws the cutscene letterbox bars and renders any queued cutscene title/subtitle text with time-based fade in/out.

results.name: cutscene_stop
results.evidence: Restores sound_set_music_gain(DAT_00686b60) if a gain was saved, clears the cutscene/letterbox-active flags set by FUN_00449720, resets a large output-camera-like struct at DAT_0071cfc4 to identity, and reports any pending cutscene error via display_error before clearing the error sentinel DAT_00718fb6 to 0xffff.
results.summary: Ends a cutscene: restores the previous music gain, clears cutscene/letterbox state, resets camera-related output fields, and surfaces any queued cutscene error.

results.name: cutscene_object_find_index_by_name
results.evidence: Linearly scans a count/array pair at unaff_ESI+0x36c/+0x370 (0x40-byte stride) calling __stricmp against unaff_EBX for each entry, returning the matching index or -1, a generic case-insensitive name-block lookup.
results.summary: Case-insensitively searches a name-indexed record array for a matching entry and returns its index, or -1 if not found.

results.name: tag_struct_upgrade_copy_fields
results.evidence: Zeroes a 0x40-byte destination header, then for up to param_2 'class versions' walks a per-version linked table (&PTR_PTR_00686d88) of {size, dest_offset} records terminated by 0xffffffff, memcpy'ing each field from the source stream (*param_1, advanced by size) into unaff_EBX+dest_offset.
results.summary: Copies a sequence of variable-sized fields from a source buffer into a destination structure according to a per-version field-layout table, used for migrating older tag/data formats.

results.name: recorded_animation_delta_apply_byte
results.evidence: Adds signed byte deltas (in_EDX[0], in_EDX[1]) to a compressed angle pair (in_EAX[0], in_EAX[1]) with wraparound at +-1000, the 2000-unit-per-circle fixed representation used by Blam's compressed recorded-animation rotation tracks.
results.summary: Applies a one-byte-per-axis compressed rotation delta to a wrapped 1000-unit fixed-point angle pair (small delta format).

results.name: recorded_animation_delta_apply_short
results.evidence: Identical wraparound-at-+-1000 logic to FUN_0044a110 but reads full 16-bit deltas from in_EDX instead of signed bytes, matching the 'large delta' variant of the same compressed rotation format.
results.summary: Applies a two-byte-per-axis compressed rotation delta to a wrapped 1000-unit fixed-point angle pair (large delta format).

results.name: recorded_animation_angle_to_vector
results.evidence: Converts a compressed yaw/pitch short pair (in_ECX[0], in_ECX[1]) to radians via *0.0031415927 (2*pi/2000, matching the +-1000 wraparound unit used by FUN_0044a110/FUN_0044a150) and writes a spherical-to-cartesian unit vector to in_EAX.
results.summary: Converts a compressed 1000-unit fixed-point yaw/pitch pair into a normalized 3D direction vector.

results.name: recorded_animation_decompress_frame_small
results.evidence: Reads a per-frame flag byte (*param_3) to decide whether to advance the forward, up axes using FUN_0044a110 (byte-delta) and FUN_0044a190 (angle-to-vector), writing results into param_2's forward/left/up fields and advancing the bitstream cursor *param_4 by 2; pairs with FUN_0044a390's 4-byte-advance large variant.
results.summary: Decodes one small-delta-format compressed animation frame, updating the forward/left/up orientation vectors based on per-axis change flags.

results.name: recorded_animation_decompress_frame_large
results.evidence: Same structure as FUN_0044a1d0 but uses FUN_0044a150 (short-delta) and advances the bitstream cursor *param_4 by 4, matching a large-delta-format compressed animation frame.
results.summary: Decodes one large-delta-format compressed animation frame, updating the forward/left/up orientation vectors based on per-axis change flags.

results.name: recorded_animation_decompress_frame_absolute
results.evidence: Reads an uncompressed yaw/pitch float pair directly from param_2 (not the +-1000 fixed-point format) and, based on a type/id field (*param_2 compared to 0x15/0x14/0x13), writes the resulting direction vector into whichever of the forward/left/up fields at param_1 aren't excluded, advancing *param_3 by 0xc.
results.summary: Applies an uncompressed absolute keyframe orientation to the forward/left/up vectors of an animation frame, sharing the direction across axes not explicitly excluded.
